doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Interim Dividend Allocation, Revision of Year-end Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase), and Change in Shareholder Return Indicator Target
doc_title_jp: 剰余金の配当(中間配当)の決定及び期末配当予想の修正(増配)、並びに株主還元指標の水準変更に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 業績見通しの上方修正に伴い、ROE目標が9%を超える見込みとなったため

summary_en: Interim dividend of ¥47 per share confirmed as previously guided for fiscal year ending March 2027. Year-end dividend forecast raised by ¥10 to ¥60 per share, bringing full-year dividend to ¥107 per share. Dividend payout target (DOE) raised from 3.6% to 4.0%, reflecting upward ROE guidance from 9% to over 9%.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期、中間配当は予想どおり1株47円に据え置き。期末配当予想を10円増配して60円に修正し、年間配当は107円。ROE目標が9%を超える見込みとなったことから、配当還元指標（DOE）を3.6%から4.0%に引き上げ。
tag_en: Interim dividend increased; FY2027 year-end dividend forecast raised; DOE target raised
tag_jp: 中間配当据え置き、期末配当増配予想、DOE水準引上げ
